About

Mary has built an HR department from the ground up, managed payroll for a 330+ employee 24/7 operation, and secured $2.5 million in payroll savings through tax credits. She guides managers, employees and unions through policy, compliance and change.

She is currently serving as an AmeriCorps VISTA member with the Fay-Penn Economic Development Council in Uniontown, Pennsylvania, supporting community and economic development in Fayette County.

Core skills

  • Employee relations, investigations and complaint resolution
  • Union contract compliance and grievance resolution
  • Employment law compliance: FMLA/CFRA, FLSA, ADA, COBRA, HIPAA, EEOC, Title VII
  • Workers' compensation, benefits administration and payroll
  • Organizational development, process improvement and project management
  • Recruitment, retention and succession planning
  • Onboarding, performance management and training delivery
